intent: Teach pedal and chain noun identification, sudden engine stopping at traffic lights without inferred cause, qualified fuel comparison, nearest petrol-station distance, seat-offer direction, every-passenger obligation and station-locker purpose.
picturePurpose: Original component pair supports two distinct tap tasks; two changing models and four evidence selections teach distance, roles, quantifiers and unreported outcomes.

workshop.title: 认部件，读清条件与要求
workshop.instruction: 点部件、切换距离和让座方向；圈出原句支持的信息。

items.label: 踏板（名词，本句）
items.prompt: pedal是哪件部件？点踏板，再读清是哪一边发声。
items.reason: My left pedal makes a clicking sound说我的左脚踏板会发出咔嗒声；不是链条发声。图仅识别部件，不能表现左右归属或声音。
items.hint: pedal可作动词表示踩踏板；本句My left pedal是名词短语。没有说明发声原因或损坏情况。
items.material: My left pedal makes a clicking sound.

options.text: 我的左脚踏板会发出咔嗒声。
原句说链条发出咔嗒声。

wordDecision.prompt: pedal是哪件部件？点踏板，再读清是哪一边发声。

art.alt: 原创部件对比：左侧为带银色短轴的黑色自行车脚踏板；右侧为由金属链节组成的闭合链条。两件分开摆放，仅供名称识别。

items.label: 链条（本句）
items.prompt: chain是哪件？点链条，分清上油的目的和已经发生的事。
items.reason: Oil the chain so it moves smoothly要求给链条上油，让它转动顺畅；so在此引出目的，不能说已经上好油或修好了。
items.hint: bicycle chain指自行车链条；这里不是连锁商店。图只识别链条，不呈现上油过程或完成状态。
items.material: Oil the chain so it moves smoothly.

options.text: 给链条上油，让它转动顺畅。
options.reason: 保留Oil the chain与so it moves smoothly的目的。

options.text: 原句要求只给踏板上油，没有提链条。

items.label: 发动机
items.prompt: 哪里、怎么停的？圈出明示信息，不猜故障原因。
items.reason: The engine stopped suddenly at the lights说发动机在红绿灯处突然熄火；没有说燃料用尽或何时修好。
items.hint: engine前用an是泛指一台发动机时的不定冠词搭配；本句特指用The engine。at the lights指红绿灯处，不是说灯坏了。

recordSelection.wrong: 应保留发动机、突然熄火与红绿灯处，不能补原因。

items.label: 燃料
items.prompt: “通常更少”能改成“总是不耗燃料”吗？圈出比较条件。
items.before: A lighter vehicle usually uses less
items.reason: A lighter vehicle usually uses less fuel说较轻的车辆通常消耗较少燃料；usually不是always，less不是none，也没有给具体节省多少。
items.hint: run out of fuel表示燃料耗尽；本句没有说耗尽。fuel是燃料的总称，不只指汽油；lighter在此是较轻的。
items.material: A lighter vehicle usually uses less fuel.

options.text: 较轻的车辆通常消耗较少燃料。
较轻的车辆总是完全不消耗燃料。

wordDecision.prompt: “通常更少”能改成“总是不耗燃料”吗？圈出比较条件。

recordSelection.wrong: 应圈较轻、通常和更少；不能改成总是零消耗。

items.label: 汽油
items.prompt: 最近还是最远？五公里还是十五公里？分别切换。
items.reason: The nearest petrol station is five kilometres away说最近的加油站在五公里外；nearest不能换成最远，five不能改成fifteen。
items.hint: 英式petrol对应美式gasoline。petrol station是加油站；图只对比距离与最近/最远，不表示道路方向、行程时间或剩余油量。
items.material: The nearest petrol station is five kilometres away.

transfer.stem: 换成自行车店、骑车人和头盔，哪组完整保留三条信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
最近的自行车店在七公里外。每位骑车人都必须保持入口畅通。请把你的头盔让给有需要的人。
词语提示：bicycle shop 自行车店；cyclist 骑车人；entrance 入口；helmet 头盔。

options.text: The nearest bicycle shop is seventeen kilometres away. Each cyclist must keep the entrance clear. Please offer your helmet to someone who needs it.
The nearest bicycle shop is seven kilometres away. Each cyclist must keep the entrance clear. Please ask someone who needs a helmet to offer their helmet to you.
The nearest bicycle shop is seven kilometres away. Each cyclist must keep the entrance clear. Please offer your helmet to someone who needs it.
The nearest bicycle shop is seven kilometres away. Every cyclist has already cleared the entrance. Please offer your helmet to someone who needs it.

answer.display: The nearest bicycle shop is seven kilometres away. Each cyclist must keep the entrance clear. Please offer your helmet to someone who needs it.

explanation.strategy: 逐项核对距离、要求与让出物品的方向。

steps.text: 最近的自行车店在七公里外：nearest ... seven kilometres away。
每位骑车人都必须保持入口畅通：Each cyclist must keep the entrance clear。
steps.reason: must表示要求，不是已经全部完成。

steps.text: 请把头盔让给有需要的人：offer your helmet to someone who needs it。
steps.reason: 让出的方向由你指向有需要的人，不能颠倒。

distractors.reason: seventeen把七公里改成十七公里。
把头盔让给谁的方向颠倒了。
has already cleared把必须做到改成已经完成。

explanation.pitfall: 数字不同、要求变结果、让出方向颠倒，任何一项变化都不行。
